title: RSTP Configuration
description: Enable Rapid PVST+ and configure edge ports for fast convergence.
scenario: Enable Rapid PVST+ and configure edge ports for fast convergence.

concepts.title: Enabling Rapid PVST+
concepts.body: Use "spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst" globally on all switches to run RSTP per VLAN.

concepts.title: Edge Ports
concepts.body: PortFast marks a port as edge. RSTP uses edge ports to skip the listening/learning states and converge instantly.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# interface FastEthernet0/1
SW1(config-if)# spanning-tree portfast

concepts.title: Point-to-Point Links
concepts.body: RSTP works best on full-duplex point-to-point links. Auto-detected; can force with "spanning-tree link-type point-to-point".

concepts.title: Verifying RSTP
concepts.body: "show spanning-tree" displays the mode and port roles. RSTP shows alternate/backup roles instead of big blocks.
concepts.code:
SW1# show spanning-tree
Spanning tree enabled protocol rstp
Role: ROOT, Altn, Desg, Bcku
